consequence.statement: No operational consequence for an operator who does nothing: the new password field is an optional alternative to passwordSecretRef, and the evidence's only caution is that the two fields are mutually exclusive, so only one may be set on a keystore section.
consequence.remediation: None required; optionally simplify existing Certificate resources by replacing passwordSecretRef with the new literal password field, setting only one of the two.

assertion.statement: cert-manager v1.17 adds an optional literal-string `password` field to the Certificate resource's keystore sections (spec.keystores.jks.password and spec.keystores.pkcs12.password) as an easier alternative to storing the keystore password in a Kubernetes secret via passwordSecretRef, and the new field is mutually exclusive with passwordSecretRef so only one of the two may be set.
